metadata.title: Logging and Telemetry

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for generating, collecting, and preserving security-relevant telemetry to support monitoring, detection, response, and forensics.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Security logging, telemetry collection, and observability technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Centralized, integrity-protected logging and telemetry architecture supporting security operations.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Logs, telemetry events, metrics, traces, timestamps, and associated metadata.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Authoritative guidance for log generation, event content, collection, storage, retention, and preparation for analysis.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines how telemetry underpins continuous monitoring, situational awareness, and risk management.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing audit event generation, telemetry content, integrity, time synchronization, retention, and monitoring support.

metadata.remarks: The Logging and Telemetry pattern defines the production and preservation of security-relevant signals. This pattern does not analyze, correlate, detect, or respond. Its sole responsibility is to ensure that trustworthy telemetry exists to enable downstream security functions.

components.title: Telemetry Generation at Sources
components.description: Generation of security-relevant telemetry by systems, applications, identities, and infrastructure components.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Telemetry exists to capture signals related to Initial Access, Execution, and Persistence activities.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: These techniques require detailed process, authentication, and configuration logging to be observable.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component operationalizes D3FEND telemetry generation and event logging mitigations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security-relevant events are defined and logged in accordance with SP 800-92 Section 3.
Audit records contain sufficient detail to support analysis and investigation.

components.title: Telemetry Collection and Transport
components.description: Secure transmission and centralized collection of telemetry from distributed sources.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Collection supports visibility into Discovery and Command and Control behaviors that span systems.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: These techniques require cross-system telemetry to observe adversary behavior.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component implements D3FEND telemetry collection and aggregation mitigations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Telemetry is transmitted and aggregated to support centralized monitoring and analysis.
Collected telemetry supports security monitoring capabilities.

components.title: Telemetry Integrity, Time, and Retention
components.description: Protection, time synchronization, and retention of telemetry to preserve evidentiary value.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Preserving telemetry integrity is critical to understanding adversary Impact activities.

props.name: d3fend-mitigations
props.remarks: This component operationalizes D3FEND data integrity and log retention mitigations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization ensures accurate correlation of events.
Telemetry is protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
Telemetry is retained to support detection, incident response, and forensic investigation.
